Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a to-do task item owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this task

title.description: Title or summary of the task

description.description: Detailed notes or description of the task

completed.description: Whether the task has been marked as finished

category.description: Category or tag name for grouping tasks

dueDate.description: Optional ISO date string for task deadline

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was last updated

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile information saved upon sign-in

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user

displayName.description: User's display name from Google Sign-In

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was first recorded

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last synchronized

/tasks/{taskId}.description: Collection of tasks isolated by owner userId

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profiles accessible only by the owner
